# Nordnet-profilen om bortglömda sektorn: ”Förbannat spännande”

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-09-28  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode centres on emerging-market fintech. Ara, the guest from Nordnet, calls it a neglected but 'förbannat spännande' sector. Platforms in Southeast Asia and Latin America such as Sea, Mercado Libre, Grab, Nu, GoTo and Creditas are using AI credit scoring on their own transaction data to lend to customers that banks cannot assess, and are adding brokerage and insurance. Loan books are growing fast and parts of the business are profitable, but the shares have done poorly for 1.5–2 years. Co-host Micke pushes back on the risks of fast loan growth, collecting the loans back, weak corporate governance and corruption. Both stress doing your own research, so the overall mood is mixed.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 SE — Sea Ltd | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Guest includes it in an EM fintech basket; loan book growing fast while the share price has lagged for 1.5–2 years.

#### Reasoning

The guest's view: e-commerce platforms can use transaction history and AI credit scoring to lend to customers banks cannot assess, at lower rates than banks. Fintech is becoming the profitable part of the business, and some companies reach break-even this quarter or next. He stresses doing your own research, and the co-host flags risks around collecting loans and governance.

#### Sell Triggers

- non-performing loans rise
- fintech unit fails to reach profitability
- regulatory tightening in Southeast Asia

> *"CIA är mest Sydostasien, men också en del Latinamerika."*

---

### 🟠 MELI — Mercado Libre | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Part of the guest's EM fintech basket in Latin America; lending growth from its own platform data.

#### Reasoning

The guest believes the market is immature and fintech lending and brokerage will carry a large share of future profits. Shares have underperformed recently. Watch rather than buy because the guest insists on your own research and the co-host warns about credit risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- credit losses rise
- lending growth slows sharply

> *"Mercado Libre är enbart Latinamerika."*

---

### 🟠 GRAB — Grab | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Southeast Asian platform in the guest's EM fintech basket.

#### Reasoning

Same thesis as the rest of the basket: platform data enables lending to customers banks cannot assess. No company-specific numbers were given, and governance and credit risks were flagged.

#### Sell Triggers

- non-performing loans rise
- regulatory problems

> *"Grab, också Sydostasien"*

---

### 🟠 NU — Nu Bank | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Fintech covering the Americas, included in the guest's basket.

#### Reasoning

Part of the EM fintech basket the guest finds exciting because of rapid loan growth and profitable fintech operations. He urged his own research, and the co-host is sceptical of fast loan growth.

#### Sell Triggers

- credit quality worsens
- growth stalls

> *"New Bank, hela Amerikakontinenterna."*

---

### 🟠 GOTO — GoTo | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Indonesian group in the EM fintech basket; bank penetration in Indonesia is low.

#### Reasoning

The guest points to Indonesia's low bank penetration and daily platform use as a lending opportunity. Speculative, and the co-host warns about governance and corruption risk in these markets.

#### Sell Triggers

- governance problems
- losses from loans not being repaid

> *"GoTo och GoEc, eller GoTo som är hela bolaget, det är Indonesien."*

---

### 🟠 VEFAB — VEF | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Stockholm-listed route to exposure to the unlisted Brazilian fintech in the guest's basket.

#### Reasoning

The guest notes the Brazilian fintech is unlisted but can be reached through VEF on the Stockholm exchange. This indirect exposure carries the same thesis, Brazilian credit risk, and the discount/valuation risk of an unlisted holding.

#### Sell Triggers

- Brazilian credit cycle worsens
- write-downs of holdings

> *"Faktiskt, man får den via VEF här på Stockholmsbörsen. Lite ironiskt, den är inte börsnoterad."*
